rows.chief_medical_and_health_office_surajpur: MBBS degree with valid registration in Chhattisgarh Medical Council

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MBBS degree recognized by Medical Council of India; Valid registration in Chhattisgarh Medical Council Age limit: 18 to 70 years (as on 1 January 2026) Other conditions: Candidate must be a local/resident of Chhattisgarh.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initial temporary appointment for 1 year or subject to availability of DMF funds.

content_sections.heading: How Will CMHO Surajpur Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Merit list based on 65% marks of essential educational qualification, 15% marks for experience, and 20% marks for interview Merit list is prepared giving 65% weightage to educational qualification, 15% to experience, and 20% to interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: 10th marksheet 12th marksheet Degree marksheet and certificate / Internship completion certificate Chhattisgarh Medical Council registration certificate Live employment registration card Experience certificate Chhattisgarh domicile certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMHO Surajpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Attend the walk-in interview on the scheduled date with filled application form and self-attested original documents. Registration will be done directly at the venue on the day of interview. Attend on 31 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Incomplete or incorrect applications will be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for CMHO Surajpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CMHO Surajpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies for Medical Officer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CMHO Surajpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 31 October 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 70 years (as on 1 January 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 56100 per month fixed.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS degree with valid registration in Chhattisgarh Medical Council.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate must be a local/resident of Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Merit list based on 65% marks of essential educational qualification, 15% marks for experience, and 20% marks for interview. Merit list is prepared giving 65% weightage to educational qualification, 15% to experience, and 20% to interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initial temporary appointment for 1 year or subject to availability of DMF funds.

faq.answer: Surajpur.
